scope: All Test420 sequences; fixed-model descriptive comparison, no tuning or model execution

comparability.input_check_limit: Checked frozen manifest and recorded stat-inventory equality; this script does not reread every image pixel.

bootstrap.unit: paired sequence; all 420 sequences sampled with replacement for each resample
bootstrap.method: percentile 2.5/97.5%; unweighted mean of per-sequence differences
bootstrap.limitation: Descriptive single-run uncertainty across sequences; not variation across training seeds; no correction for simultaneous metrics.

limitations: B+D versus V4 combines structural policy changes, removal of reverse verification, UAV LoRAT fine-tuning, candidate computation and D; cannot attribute the difference to temporal modeling alone.
TF32 differs: V4 false and B+D true. Same hardware and timing formula do not make this a controlled module-speed ablation.
No B-only Test420 or D0 Test420 ablation is provided by this comparison. Temporal-specific evidence remains the prior Val132 D versus D0 result.
No physical-absence classifier; mACC uses existing four-number exports. No target identity guarantee is implied.
The Test420 comparison is descriptive on the fixed models; do not use these Test results to retune or reselect.
